verdict.rationale: Vanta ships AI features (the Vanta AI Agent and Vanta AI evidence review), so whether customer data is excluded from AI model training is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains no training opt-out, no data-usage policy, and no no-training commitment. The GDPR 'privacy workflows' help customers run their own compliance programs and are an adjacent feature, not a control over Vanta's use of their data.
